title: Liquid drum and bass
style: English, British accent, female vocal, liquid drum and bass, rolling breakbeats, deep sub bass, lush pads, 174 bpm
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Midnight running through the city lights,
Every heartbeat burning bright,
I can feel the rhythm in my veins,
Washing over me like summer rain.

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on to me,
We're the river to the sea,
Let it carry, let it flow,
Never gonna let you go.

[Verse]
Concrete jungle humming low,
Neon rivers in the glow,
Every shadow knows our name,
Nothing's ever gonna be the same.

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on to me,
We're the river to the sea,
Let it carry, let it flow,
Never gonna let you go.

[Outro]
